from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Section title and lecture lines
        title_text = "Geometric Intuition: The 'Infinite Zoom' and Tangents"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Now, let's look at a curving roller coaster.",
            "The slope changes at every point along the track.",
            "Zooming in closer, the curve begins to flatten.",
            "Eventually, it looks just like a straight line.",
            "This \"local line\" is the tangent to the curve."
        ]
        
        # Initialize layout
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)
        
        # Color definitions
        CURVE_YELLOW = "#FFFF00"
        TANGENT_BLUE = "#0000FF"
        HIGHLIGHT_WHITE = "#FFFFFF"
        
        # Ensure lecture text stays on top and add background mask
        self.lecture.set_z_index(30)
        self.title.set_z_index(30)
        
        # Background mask to prevent zoom bleed into lecture area
        # Grid covers x from 0.5 to 5.5. Left side is roughly x < 0.5.
        lecture_area_mask = Rectangle(
            width=6, height=10, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0
        ).to_edge(LEFT, buff=0)
        lecture_area_mask.set_z_index(20)
        self.add(lecture_area_mask)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Now, let's look at a curving roller coaster.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(CURVE_YELLOW)
        
        # Setup Axes and Curve
        # Using a coordinate system that fits well in the grid
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-2.5, 2.5, 1],
            y_range=[-1.5, 1.5, 1],
            x_length=4.5,
            y_length=3.5,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "stroke_width": 2, "color": GRAY}
        )
        
        # f(x) = 0.1*(x^3 - 4x) - a standard curve with varying slope
        def coaster_func(x):
            return 0.1 * (x**3 - 4 * x)
            
        curve = axes.plot(coaster_func, x_range=[-2.2, 2.2], color=CURVE_YELLOW)
        graph_group = VGroup(axes, curve)
        
        # Position the graph in the right-side grid area
        self.place_in_area(graph_group, "B2", "E5")
        
        self.play(Create(axes), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(curve), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # The slope changes at every point along the track.
        # We highlight the point of interest P
        
        # Target Point P at x=0 (the center of our zoom)
        x_p = 0
        p_coords = axes.c2p(x_p, coaster_func(x_p))
        point_p = Dot(p_coords, color=HIGHLIGHT_WHITE)
        # Rule L003: Label within 1 grid unit. Positioning UR is close.
        label_p = Text("P", font_size=20, color=HIGHLIGHT_WHITE)
        label_p.next_to(point_p, UR, buff=0.1)
        
        # Demonstration dot sliding along the curve to show changing slope
        sliding_dot = Dot(color=HIGHLIGHT_WHITE, radius=0.07)
        sliding_dot.move_to(axes.c2p(-2, coaster_func(-2)))
        
        self.play(FadeIn(point_p), Write(label_p))
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(sliding_dot, curve), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
        self.play(FadeOut(sliding_dot))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Zooming in closer, the curve begins to flatten.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(CURVE_YELLOW)
        
        # Introduce magnifying glass (Circle) at point P
        mag_glass = Circle(radius=0.5, color=HIGHLIGHT_WHITE, stroke_width=4)
        mag_glass.move_to(point_p.get_center())
        mag_glass.set_z_index(5)
        
        self.play(Create(mag_glass))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        # First stage of zoom: Scale graph around P
        zoom_factor_1 = 6.0
        self.play(
            graph_group.animate.scale(zoom_factor_1, about_point=point_p.get_center()),
            mag_glass.animate.scale(2.5),
            label_p.animate.scale(0.8).next_to(point_p, UR, buff=0.05),
            run_time=3
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Eventually, it looks just like a straight line.
        # Keep line 4 white to indicate the result of the zoom
        
        # Second stage of zoom - very high magnification to "flatten" the curve visually
        zoom_factor_2 = 5.0
        self.play(
            graph_group.animate.scale(zoom_factor_2, about_point=point_p.get_center()),
            run_time=2.5
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # This "local line" is the tangent to the curve.
        self.lecture[4].set_color(TANGENT_BLUE)
        
        # f(x) = 0.1*(x^3 - 4x) => f'(x) = 0.1*(3x^2 - 4)
        # At x=0, slope m = 0.1 * (-4) = -0.4
        slope = -0.4
        
        # Direction vector for slope -0.4: (1, -0.4, 0)
        direction = np.array([1, slope, 0])
        
        # Create tangent line passing through P
        # Length is chosen to cover the magnified view within the glass circle
        tangent_line = Line(
            start=point_p.get_center() - 3.5 * direction,
            end=point_p.get_center() + 3.5 * direction,
            color=TANGENT_BLUE,
            stroke_width=6
        )
        tangent_line.set_z_index(6)
        
        # Final reveals
        self.play(Create(tangent_line))
        # Rule L004: Use Indicate
        self.play(Indicate(tangent_line, color=TANGENT_BLUE))
        self.wait(3)
